business_problem: The company's construction content platform needed faster, more relevant search across 800,000 heterogeneous components from hundreds of manufacturers, but relational databases and early fuzzy search approaches returned too many results and were hard to scale.
solution_summary: A leading technology company rebuilt the search layer behind its construction estimating content platform on MongoDB Atlas and MongoDB Search after relational databases struggled with 800,000 heterogeneous components supplied by hundreds of manufacturers. Product attributes arrived as jagged JSON arrays, so the team used MongoDB's document model to store variable fields and built aggregation-pipeline queries with wildcard searches across component properties. After early fuzzy matching still returned too many results, MongoDB specialists helped the team redesign the search experience with Search Facets, drill-down classifications, optional filters, and a custom analyzer that kept hyphenated catalog numbers in a single token. Hosted on Azure, the Atlas-based design now supports more relevant discovery, operational self-service, and scale toward tens of millions of components.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the construction content platform's heterogeneous component data in a flexible document model.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Search
solution_components.role: Provides faceted and text search over component fields so estimators can find relevant products quickly.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Flex Consulting
solution_components.role: Advised the team on complex indexing, search facets, and analyzer design for the new search experience.

data_flow: Manufacturer component data lands in MongoDB Atlas as JSON-style documents. Aggregation pipelines and MongoDB Search indexes query those records, then drill-down facets, filters, and a custom analyzer refine the results delivered to estimators building project quotes.
business_outcome: The Atlas-based search stack made searches 5x faster, reduced result sets from 10,000 hits to 100 relevant matches, improved search aggregation by 80%, and gave the platform room to scale to 30-50 million components.
